#!/usr/local/bin/python3
"""TASK-20261002-aeaf93 (J6): compare the version-4 CB-3 printed outputs (in-force
log, audit sheet session_computations.round_1.relay) with this validator's own
values (j6_core.out.json). Reads the audit sheet from the snapshot commit bytes
(git show b188c6a4:<path>, piped on stdin). Does not execute any producer code."""
import json, sys, hashlib, yaml

audit = yaml.safe_load(sys.stdin.read())["proof_search_map_audit"]
mine = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
r1 = audit["session_computations"]["round_1"]
parts = [r1["relay"][f"part_{i}"] for i in range(1, 8)]
text = "".join(parts)
h = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
res = {"relay_reconstruction": {"sha256_concat": h, "sha256_as_relayed": r1["relay"]["sha256_as_relayed"],
                                "equal": h == r1["relay"]["sha256_as_relayed"], "lines": text.count("\n"),
                                "lines_declared": r1["relay"]["lines"]}}
lines = text.split("\n")
i0 = lines.index("==== C-4")
start = next(i for i in range(i0, len(lines)) if lines[i] == "{")
stop = next(i for i in range(start, len(lines)) if lines[i] == "---- c4.err")
c4 = json.loads("\n".join(lines[start:stop]))
res["c4_keys"] = sorted(c4.keys())

# ---- A_571_by_m
amax = 0.0; rows = 0; mism = []
for r in c4["A_571_by_m"]:
    m = r["m"]
    mr = next(x for x in mine["A_571_by_m"] if x["m"] == m)
    pairs = []
    for key, val in r.items():
        pass
    rows += 1
    res.setdefault("A_571_by_m_row_example", r) if m == 2 else None
res["A_571_by_m_cb3_row_keys"] = sorted(c4["A_571_by_m"][0].keys())
print(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
json.dump(c4, open(sys.argv[2], "w"), indent=1)

#!/usr/local/bin/python3
"""TASK-20261002-aeaf93 (J6): field-by-field comparison of CB-3's printed C-4
outputs (cb3_c4_output.json, extracted from the reconstructed relay) with this
validator's own exact values (j6_core.out.json). Tolerances: the plan's 0.05 bit
(exact on m), and also the half-unit of each printed figure's own precision."""
import json, sys
from decimal import Decimal

c4 = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
mine = json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))


def halfunit(v):
    s = repr(v)
    if "e" in s or "E" in s:
        mant, exp = s.lower().split("e")
        dec = len(mant.split(".")[1]) if "." in mant else 0
        return 0.5 * 10 ** (int(exp) - dec)
    dec = len(s.split(".")[1]) if "." in s else 0
    return 0.5 * 10 ** (-dec)


rep = {"checked": 0, "beyond_plan_tol_0.05": [], "beyond_print_halfunit": [], "max_abs_diff": 0.0}


def cmp(label, cb, mv, exact=False):
    rep["checked"] += 1
    if exact:
        if cb != mv:
            rep["beyond_plan_tol_0.05"].append([label, cb, mv])
        return
    d = abs(float(cb) - float(mv))
    if d > rep["max_abs_diff"]:
        rep["max_abs_diff"] = d; rep["max_abs_diff_at"] = [label, cb, mv]
    if d > 0.05:
        rep["beyond_plan_tol_0.05"].append([label, cb, mv, d])
    if d > halfunit(cb) * 1.0000001 + 1e-15:
        rep["beyond_print_halfunit"].append([label, cb, mv, d, halfunit(cb)])


KMAP = {"MI1": "MI1", "ceiled": "CEIL"}
for r in c4["A_571_by_m"]:
    m = r["m"]; me = next(x for x in mine["A_571_by_m"] if x["m"] == m)
    for kr in ("MI1", "ceiled"):
        K = KMAP[kr]
        for pf in ("PF1", "PF2"):
            cmp(f"A571 m={m} {kr} {pf}", r[f"A_{kr}_{pf}"], me[f"A_{K}_{pf}"])
        cmp(f"A571 m={m} PF2-PF1 {kr}", r[f"PF2_minus_PF1_{kr}"], me[f"PF2_minus_PF1_{K}"])
        cmp(f"A571 m={m} store {kr}", r[f"relation_store_{kr}"], me[f"relation_store_log2_{K}"])
    for pf in ("PF1", "PF2"):
        cmp(f"A571 m={m} ceil-MI1 {pf}", r[f"ceiled_minus_MI1_{pf}"], me[f"CEIL_minus_MI1_{pf}"])

for line in c4["MI2_consequence"]:
    n = line["n"]; K = "MI1" if line["k_reading"] == "MI-1" else "CEIL"
    me = mine["MI2_consequence"][f"{n}_{K}"]
    for pf, pk in (("PF-2", "PF2"), ("PF-1", "PF1")):
        cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} {pf} C_I", line[pf]["C_I"], me[pk]["C_I"])
        cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} {pf} argmin", line[pf]["m_star"], me[pk]["argmin"], exact=True)
        cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} {pf} runner_up", line[pf]["runner_up_m"], me[pk]["runner_up"], exact=True)
        cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} {pf} gap", line[pf]["runner_up_gap"], me[pk]["gap"])
        cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} {pf} store", line[pf]["memory_at_m_star"]["relation_store"], me[pk]["relation_store_log2"])
        cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} {pf} MR_B", line[pf]["memory_at_m_star"]["MR_B"], me[pk]["MR_B_D4"])
        cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} {pf} MR_M", line[pf]["memory_at_m_star"]["MR_M"], me[pk]["MR_M_D4"])
    cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} move", line["move_PF1_minus_PF2"], float(me["move_PF1_minus_PF2"]))
    cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} argmin_changes", line["argmin_changes"], me["argmin_changes"], exact=True)
    cmp(f"MI2cons {n} {K} exceeds_F2", line["move_exceeds_F2_tolerance"], me["abs_move_exceeds_1e-9"], exact=True)

fx_out = []
for line in c4["MI2_fixture"]:
    K = "MI1" if line["k_reading"] == "MI-1" else "CEIL"; pk = line["P_form"].replace("-", "")
    me = mine["fixture_as_frozen"][f"{K}_{pk}"]
    fx_out.append({kk: vv for kk, vv in line.items() if kk not in ("n_571", "n_283")})
    cmp(f"MI2fix {K} {pk} overall", line["pass_rule"], me["overall"], exact=True)
    for n in ("571", "283"):
        t = line[f"n_{n}"]
        cmp(f"MI2fix {K} {pk} {n} value", t["C_I"], me[n]["value"])
        cmp(f"MI2fix {K} {pk} {n} argmin", t["m_star"], me[n]["argmin"], exact=True)
        cmp(f"MI2fix {K} {pk} {n} distance", t["abs_distance"], float(me[n]["abs_distance"]))
        cmp(f"MI2fix {K} {pk} {n} slack", t["slack"], float(me[n]["slack"]))
        cmp(f"MI2fix {K} {pk} {n} pass", t["passes"], me[n]["pass"], exact=True)

d = c4["MI2_direction"]
cmp("MI2dir cells", d["cells"], 2 * mine["MI2_direction"]["cells_per_k_reading"], exact=True)
cmp("MI2dir below", d["A_PF1_below_A_PF2"], mine["MI2_direction"]["PF1_below_PF2"], exact=True)
cmp("MI2dir notbelow", d["A_PF1_not_below_A_PF2"], mine["MI2_direction"]["PF1_not_below_PF2"], exact=True)

s = c4["ceiled_vs_MI1_cells"]; me = mine["MI1_direction_PF2"]
cmp("MI1dir cells", s["cells"], me["cells"], exact=True)
cmp("MI1dir below", s["ceiled_below_MI1"], me["ceiled_below"], exact=True)
cmp("MI1dir equal", s["equal"], me["equal"], exact=True)
cmp("MI1dir above", s["ceiled_above_MI1"], me["above"], exact=True)
cmp("MI1dir equal_cells", s["equal_cells"], me["equal_cells"], exact=True)
cmp("MI1dir per-degree minima below", s["per_degree_minima_ceiled_below_MI1"], me["degrees_with_ceiled_CI_below_MI1_CI"], exact=True)

for line in c4["threshold_table_comparisons"]:
    print("CB3 ttc line:", json.dumps(line))
for line in c4["threshold_table_tokens"]:
    print("CB3 tok line:", json.dumps(line))
for line in c4["reachability_by_reading"]:
    K = "MI1" if line["k_reading"] == "MI-1" else "CEIL"; pk = line["P_form"].replace("-", "")
    sc = mine["scored_cells_m12"][f"{K}_{pk}"]
    mv = [sc["K-571|R-B"], sc["K-571|R-M"], sc["B-571|R-B"], sc["B-571|R-M"]]
    cmp(f"scored cells m=12 {K} {pk} (order K-B, K-M, B-B, B-M assumed)", line["scored_cells_D_star"], mv, exact=True)

# kreading table (PF-2, both k readings) against the validator's PF-2 values
for line in c4["kreading_table"]:
    n = line["n"]; me = mine["kreading_table_PF2"][str(n)]
    cmp(f"kread {n} MI1 C_I", line["MI-1"]["C_I"], me["MI1"][0]); cmp(f"kread {n} MI1 m", line["MI-1"]["m_star"], me["MI1"][1], exact=True)
    cmp(f"kread {n} CEIL C_I", line["ceiled"]["C_I"], me["CEIL"][0]); cmp(f"kread {n} CEIL m", line["ceiled"]["m_star"], me["CEIL"][1], exact=True)

print(json.dumps(rep, indent=1))
print("MI2_fixture CB3 lines (targets omitted):", json.dumps(fx_out))

#!/usr/local/bin/python3
"""TASK-20261002-aeaf93 (J6 iii): figures ADDED in v4 spec fields (count increased
over the frozen v3 field at the same path, or new fields), each classified against
the validator's reference values (j6_reference.out.json, j6_core.out.json) by value at
its printed precision. Unclassified decimals are listed with context for manual
reading."""
import json, re, sys, yaml
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from j6_dcarry2 import flatten, toks  # same tokenizer and flattener as j6_dcarry2.py
S = sys.argv[1]
v3 = {p: str(t) for p, t in flatten(yaml.safe_load(open(f"{S}/v3spec.yaml", encoding="utf-8")))}
v4 = {p: str(t) for p, t in flatten(yaml.safe_load(open(f"{S}/v4spec.yaml", encoding="utf-8")))}
added = []
for p, t in v4.items():
    c4 = toks(t); c3 = toks(v3.get(p, ""))
    for k, n4 in c4.items():
        if n4 > c3.get(k, 0):
            i = t.find(k[1])
            added.append({"path": p, "kind": k[0], "tok": k[1], "added": n4 - c3.get(k, 0), "ctx": t[max(0, i - 90): i + 40].replace("\n", " ")})
print(json.dumps({"added_count": len(added), "added": added}, indent=1))

#!/usr/local/bin/python3
"""TASK-20261002-aeaf93: false-PASS tests of the validator's own checks (V4B-8).
M1: perturb one CB-3 MI-2 figure by one unit in its last printed digit and confirm
    j6_compare2.py flags it; perturb one argmin and confirm the exact check flags it.
M2: change one carried memory token in a copy of the v4 spec and confirm the
    count-based D-CARRY diff (j6_dcarry2.py) reports a decrease at that path.
Every mutation is made on copies inside mut/; no input file is touched."""
import json, subprocess, shutil, os, sys
S = sys.argv[1]; M = os.path.join(S, "mut"); out = {}
c = json.load(open(f"{S}/cb3_c4_output.json"))
c1 = json.loads(json.dumps(c)); c1["MI2_consequence"][2]["PF-1"]["C_I"] = 147.6494774   # was 147.6494764
json.dump(c1, open(f"{M}/cb3_m1.json", "w"))
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", f"{S}/j6_compare2.py", f"{M}/cb3_m1.json", f"{S}/j6_core.out.json"], capture_output=True, text=True)
out["M1a_value_mutation_flagged"] = '"beyond_print_halfunit": []' not in r.stdout
c2 = json.loads(json.dumps(c)); c2["MI2_consequence"][0]["PF-1"]["m_star"] = 13
json.dump(c2, open(f"{M}/cb3_m2.json", "w"))
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", f"{S}/j6_compare2.py", f"{M}/cb3_m2.json", f"{S}/j6_core.out.json"], capture_output=True, text=True)
out["M1b_argmin_mutation_flagged"] = '"beyond_plan_tol_0.05": []' not in r.stdout
# M2: a copy directory holding the frozen v3 spec and a v4 spec mutated in a CARRIED field
# (frozen_c2_fixture.pass_rule carries the 283 target 147.649 from version 3)
os.makedirs(f"{M}/d", exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy(f"{S}/v3spec.yaml", f"{M}/d/v3spec.yaml")
t = open(f"{S}/v4spec.yaml", encoding="utf-8").read()
i = t.index("C_I(283, 3.0) against 147.649"); t2 = t[:i] + "C_I(283, 3.0) against 147.648" + t[i + len("C_I(283, 3.0) against 147.649"):]
open(f"{M}/d/v4spec.yaml", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t2)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", f"{S}/j6_dcarry2.py", f"{M}/d"], capture_output=True, text=True)
res = json.loads(r.stdout)
out["M2_carried_token_mutation_flagged"] = [[d["path"], d["tok"], d["v3_count"], d["v4_count_same_path"]] for d in res["decreased_at_same_path"] if d["tok"] == "147.649"]
out["M2_decrease_count_vs_unmutated_2"] = len(res["decreased_at_same_path"])
# M3: a wrong value in a NEW v4 field (MI-2.disclosed_consequence) is caught by the reference check
os.makedirs(f"{M}/e", exist_ok=True)
for f in ("v3spec.yaml", "hyp_v4.yaml", "audit_v4.yaml", "worksheet_v4.yaml", "j6_reference.out.json"):
    shutil.copy(f"{S}/{f}", f"{M}/e/{f}")
t = open(f"{S}/v4spec.yaml", encoding="utf-8").read()
i = t.index("relation store 2^35.90 at both"); t3 = t[:i] + "relation store 2^35.91 at both" + t[i + len("relation store 2^35.90 at both"):]
open(f"{M}/e/v4spec.yaml", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t3)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", f"{S}/j6_dcarry.py", f"{M}/e"], capture_output=True, text=True)
res = json.loads(r.stdout)
out["M3_new_field_wrong_value_flagged_as_near_miss"] = [[x["path"], x["tok"], x["near"][:1]] for x in res["v4_reference_check"]["spec"]["near_miss_only"] if x["tok"] == "2^35.91"]
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))

# TASK-20261002-aeaf93: (a) relay reconstruction and CB-3 output extraction (j6_compare.py);
# (b) TA-1 word scan of the four version-4 files at the snapshot commit;
# (c) TA-3 static check of the committed code blocks CB-1, CB-3, CB-4.
REPO=/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher
S=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/f42055f8-3588-569d-b7d9-926d696d2468/scratchpad/BATCH-bc5bd5/TASK-20261002-aeaf93

D=coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP2M-001/batches/BATCH-bc5bd5/design/TASK-20261002-e11714
cd "$REPO"
echo "==== (a) relay reconstruction"
git show $C:$D/proof-search-map-audit.yaml | /usr/local/bin/python3 -I -B $S/j6_compare.py $S/j6_core.out.json $S/cb3_c4_output.json | head -12
sha256sum $S/cb3_c4_output.json
echo "==== (b) TA-1 scan (whole word, case-insensitive) of the four version-4 files"
for p in experiments/EXP-NISTBIN-451dfa/specification.yaml $D/proof-search-map-audit.yaml $D/revision-worksheet.yaml; do
  echo "-- $p"; git show $C:$p | grep -n -i -w -E 'live|dead|decides|deciding|decisive' | cut -c1-200
done
echo "-- ledger/hypotheses/H-NISTBIN-dec5e1.yaml (version_4 block, from byte 93253)"
git show $C:ledger/hypotheses/H-NISTBIN-dec5e1.yaml | tail -c +93253 | grep -n -i -w -E 'live|dead|decides|deciding|decisive' | cut -c1-200
echo "==== (c) TA-3 static check"
git show $C:$D/proof-search-map-audit.yaml | /usr/local/bin/python3 -I -B -c '
import sys, yaml, ast, hashlib
a = yaml.safe_load(sys.stdin.read())["proof_search_map_audit"]["code_blocks"]
for cb in ("CB-1", "CB-3", "CB-4"):
    src = a[cb]["source"]; h = hashlib.sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest()
    print(cb, a[cb].get("name"), len(src.encode()), h, "equals reference:", h == a[cb].get("reference_sha256"))
    for pat in ("joint_balance", "runs/", "subprocess", "os.system", "open("):
        hits = [i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(src.split("\n")) if pat in l]
        if hits: print("   ", repr(pat), "at lines", hits[:12])
    tree = ast.parse(src)
    kinds = sorted({type(n).__name__ for n in tree.body})

    calls = [ast.unparse(n)[:60] for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Expr) and not isinstance(n.value, ast.Constant)]

print("CB-3 lines 16-18:", " / ".join(lines3[15:18]))
print("CB-4 lines 99-101:", " / ".join(l.strip() for l in lines4[98:101]))
'
echo "==== exit"

#!/usr/local/bin/python3
"""TASK-20261002-aeaf93: parse the validation report and lint it (V4B-12, V4B-13).
(1) yaml.safe_load; (2) no prose ': ' outside block scalars (flow mappings exempt);
(3) no mapping key at list-item indent; (4) no TA-1 word in this card's own text;
(5) no 'D* ... = <digit>' value statement."""
import sys, yaml, re
p = sys.argv[1]; txt = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read(); d = yaml.safe_load(txt)
print("parsed OK; top keys:", list(d.keys()))
print("verdicts:", d["review_attestation"]["verdicts"], "| read_sibling_reports:", d["review_attestation"]["read_sibling_reports"])
lines = txt.split("\n"); issues = []; in_block = False; bind = 0
for i, s in enumerate(lines, 1):
    if not s.strip() or s.lstrip().startswith("#"): continue
    ind = len(s) - len(s.lstrip())
    if in_block:
        if ind > bind: continue
        in_block = False
    body = s.lstrip()
    if re.search(r":\s*(>-|\|)$", body): in_block = True; bind = ind; continue
    m = re.match(r"^(- )?([A-Za-z0-9_\-\./ ]+):\s?(.*)$", body)
    val = m.group(3) if m else (body[2:] if body.startswith("- ") else body)
    if val.startswith(("{", "[")): continue
    if ": " in val: issues.append((i, s[:120]))
print("prose colon-space outside block scalars:", issues or "none")
bad = []
for i in range(1, len(lines)):
    b = lines[i]
    if b.strip() and not b.lstrip().startswith(("-", "#")) and re.match(r"^\s*[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+:", b):
        ib = len(b) - len(b.lstrip()); j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 and (not lines[j].strip() or len(lines[j]) - len(lines[j].lstrip()) > ib): j -= 1
        if j >= 0 and lines[j].lstrip().startswith("- ") and len(lines[j]) - len(lines[j].lstrip()) == ib: bad.append((i + 1, b[:100]))
print("mapping key at list-item indent:", bad or "none")
words = ["li" + "ve", "de" + "ad", "deci" + "des", "deci" + "ding", "deci" + "sive"]
print("TA-1 words in report:", {w: [k + 1 for k, l in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r"\b%s\b" % w, l, re.I)] for w in words})
print("D* value statements:", [k + 1 for k, l in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r"D\*[^,;]{0,12}=\s*\d", l)] or "none")
